text:
chris_ops: t-minus 45m — final standby huddle. Quick checklist below, please ack when done. I’ll call go/no-go at T-10.

chris_ops: checklist: 
• pin release in deploy-bot to v3.4.1
• confirm canary traffic routing (eu-west + us-east)
• watch p95 latency and error rate dashboards
• release notes posted, cherrypicks merged
• rollback owner assigned + rollback command verified
• freeze mode enabled for docs + infra changes

maya_release: acked. release notes link: https://go/redwood/releases/3.4.1 :thumbsup:

alex_platform: canary pods warming now, scaling to 3 replicas in eu-west. watching infra. :eyes:

deploy-bot: canary rollout started -> service/llm-api @ v3.4.1 (3 pods)
deploy-bot: traffic split: 5% canary (eu-west/us-east), 95% baseline

sre_oncall: monitoring: p95 latency target <= 200ms, error-rate spike threshold 0.5% above baseline = rollback trigger. I’ll take first action if threshold breached.

chris_ops: rollback owner = alexandra (sre_oncall). If triggered, use the rollback command below and notify slack channel + pager.

chris_ops: rollback command (verified on staging):
```
# rollback to previous stable tag
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/llm-api --to-revision=tags/v3.3.9
# then pin deploy-bot to v3.3.9 and disable canary traffic
```

pm_lex: release notes summary posted in #marketing and product. No external docs release during freeze window until +1h post-success.

maya_release: quick pin step done — deploy-bot config shows pinned_version: v3.4.1. Confirmed in UI.

alex_platform: perf smoke looks good so far. KV cache warm and no OOMs. CPU on canary pods ~35%.

sre_oncall: added Grafana alert: llm-api.canary.error_rate > 0.5% for 60s -> escalation. Also added synthetic smoke every 30s to canary route.

chris_ops: freeze rules: no schema migrations, no infra config changes, no new feature flags during the next 90 minutes. If you need an exemption file a ticket with reason + approver.

maya_release: acknowledging freeze. If we need a hotfix, we follow hotfix exemption flow and coordinate in this thread.

deploy-bot: canary metrics: 200 requests, 5 errors (2.5%), avg latency 180ms — keep eyes on error-rate.

sre_oncall: noted. error-rate creeping, but traffic still small. Will watch the 5m window.

alex_platform: looking at traces — two requests hit a new quantization path that added 30ms, not the error cause. Investigating third-party tokeniser latency.

chris_ops: plan if error-rate crosses threshold: 1) pause traffic split -> 0% canary 2) trigger rollback command 3) notify customer-facing teams 4) follow RCA postmortem.

pm_lex: customer comms on standby. I’ll draft a short blast if we roll back.

maya_release: ack. tagging QA to hold off post-release tests during freeze.

sre_oncall: alert fired (canary.error_rate > 0.5%) — manual check running.

sre_oncall: manual check: errors due to tokeniser 502 upstream, not rollout code. recommend pause canary traffic and failover to baseline.

deploy-bot: pausing canary traffic -> traffic split set to 0% canary, 100% baseline.

alex_platform: confirmed canary pods drained, no active traffic.

chris_ops: on decision — we will not rollback for now since failure is upstream. We will keep canary paused and coordinate hotfix with integration team. If upstream fix not delivered in 20m we will rollback.

maya_release: understood. holding on rollback for 20m.

pm_lex: keeping comms draft ready, holding off send.

sre_oncall: continuing monitoring. I’ll re-escalate if any regression on baseline or if canary errors persist after resume.

chris_ops: thanks all. please post quick status updates in this thread — will call final lift at T+1h if stable. :white_check_mark:
